source: RFC 0007 §6.5 (review of 2026-11-21's merges, R3-11: the size of a status; maintainer's coordinator, 2026-11-22)
statement: An instance's status is small: its instance, when, its format level, whether it shadows and the windows it acknowledges, and no document it holds. Liveness, the acknowledgement of a shadow window and the window's closing path read only statuses and never an instance's resident documents, so what they read per instance does not grow with the documents it holds.
guards: cocache:StatusSplitTest#what the acknowledgement reads does not grow with the documents an instance holds
control:ShadowAcknowledgementTest#the closing path reads no resident record
document:ShadowCodecTest#a status of 8_0_0-beta_5 reads, its documents ignored
